payload.description:
Run Test 1 from docs/FEASIBILITY_TESTS.md as disposable spike code.

Acceptance criteria:
- Emit numbered SSE frames every 250 ms for at least 20 minutes.
- Capture client receive times for direct and CloudFront paths.
- Report p50, p95, batching, disconnect boundary, and Last-Event-ID recovery.
- Repeat with a backgrounded tab and mobile Safari.
- Record the pass or failure branch in the gated design document.

Not included: DynamoDB, authentication, model calls, workers, or production code.
payload.title: Run the Lambda and CloudFront SSE feasibility spike
